name: kahoot-pro-platform
description: Kahoot-Style Multimedia & Educational Quiz Platform (Live Arena, Self-Paced, KaTeX, <=100MB Media, Analytics)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
